## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasEPSElement(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `EPSParseDiagnostics`

Triage data for "the file displays wrong": operators the interpreter does not implement (with use counts) point at missing features, and warnings mark places where it recovered from a defect or fell back to an approximation.
